title: A Familiar Face
content:
The meeting was only a few minutes away.

Siddu was busy reviewing a few documents in his cabin when there was a gentle knock on the door.

"Come in."

Rose stepped inside.

"Sir," she said politely, "the representatives from the Indian company have arrived. They're waiting for you in the conference hall."

Siddu closed the file in front of him.

"Alright."

"Ask them to wait for a moment."

"Yes, sir."

Rose nodded before quietly leaving the cabin.

Siddu straightened his blazer, adjusted his tie, and took a slow breath.

For some reason...

His heart felt unusually restless.

He dismissed the feeling and walked toward the conference hall.

________________________________________

A few moments later...

He reached the large glass conference room.

As the automatic doors slid open, everyone inside immediately stood up.

"Good morning, sir."

Siddu smiled politely.

"Good morning, everyone."

As he looked around the room, his eyes suddenly stopped on one face.

His footsteps froze.

"Shreya...?"

He thought his eyes were deceiving him.

He looked again.

It really was her.

After five long years...

She was standing right in front of him.

His heartbeat skipped.

The words he was about to say disappeared.

For a moment, even his breathing became unsteady.

But years of experience had taught him how to hide his emotions.

Within seconds...

He regained his composure.

A gentle professional smile appeared on his face as though nothing had happened.

He walked toward his seat and sat down.

Across the table...

Shreya quietly noticed the brief struggle in his eyes.

But she chose to remain silent.

One of the Indian delegates stood up.

"Good morning, sir."

"My name is Varun, and I'm representing our company."

He smiled toward the woman beside him.

"This is my manager, Ms. Shreya."

Siddu looked at her once again.

Then, pretending they were meeting for the very first time, he smiled politely.

"It's a pleasure to meet you."

Shreya returned the same professional smile.

"The pleasure is mine."

For a brief second...

Their eyes met.

Five years of memories passed silently between them.

Then...

The meeting began.

________________________________________

Nearly an hour later...

The discussion came to an end.

Both companies were satisfied with the outcome.

Varun stepped forward first.

"Thank you for your time, sir."

He extended his hand.

Siddu smiled and shook it.

"It was a pleasure."

Then Shreya walked forward.

Without saying a word...

She slowly extended her hand.

For the smallest fraction of a second...

Siddu's eyes softened.

He hadn't imagined that after five years, the first thing connecting them again would be a simple handshake.

Quietly...

He reached out and shook her hand.

"Thank you," Shreya said professionally.

"You're welcome," Siddu replied.

Neither of them allowed their emotions to show.

Varun looked at Siddu and smiled.

"Our team will be staying in France for a month."

"I hope we'll have the opportunity to work together again."

Siddu nodded.

"Of course."

"We'll be in touch."

"Thank you, sir."

With that...

Varun and Shreya left the conference hall.

________________________________________

By evening...

The office had almost emptied.

Employees slowly made their way home.

Siddu picked up his coat and walked toward the exit.

As he passed through the corridor, he stopped beside the enormous glass wall overlooking the city.

The golden rays of the setting sun painted the sky in shades of orange and crimson.

He stood there quietly...

Lost in thought.

The entire office had become silent.

Then...

A familiar voice broke the silence.

"How are you, Siddu?"

Without turning around...

A faint smile appeared on his face.

"I'm fine, Shreya."

Slowly...

He turned to face the person he hadn't truly spoken to in five years.
